title: Preparation of Graphite Intercalation Compound of Niobium Fluoride in Fluorine Atmosphere
abstract: Abstract                The 1st stage intercalation compound of graphite with niobium fluoride has been prepared in fluorine gas of 101 kPa. The composition is C8−10NbF6−7 with repeat distance of 0.818–0.834 nm. The highest electrical conductivity is 1.2×105 S cm−1 at stage 2+3.
